text:
Rahul: Locking the NorthBloom private rollout window for Thu Apr 2 22:00-23:30 PT. Need final ack from SRE, Infra, Security, KMS, and CS. Model pinned to redwood-v2-quantized@2026-03-28. Canaries will run on slice-7. Please reply with :thumbsup: or raise issues.

Joanne: Confirmed model pin. Canary plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full shift. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/northbloom-rollout (internal).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: job_id=deploy-3912345678, window=2026-04-03T05:00Z-06:30Z, canary_slice=slice-7. Preflight checks queued.

Elena: Heads up — KMS rotation currently scheduled same night at Apr 2 23:45 PT. That could collide with post-canary operations. @Security can we move or confirm?

Ava: CS confirms NorthBloom is okay with 22:00 start but asked for a 30m canary duration to observe real traffic patterns.

Mike: Need explicit rollback policy and thresholds before we lock. Propose: rollback if 5xx > 2% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency increases by >200ms sustained 10m. Also require slice-level CPU/gpu util and KV cache hit-rate alarms.

Joanne: Adding rollback triggers and health checks to the runbook. Snippet below:
```
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: http_5xx_percent
    threshold: 2
    duration: 10m
  - metric: p95_latency_increase_ms
    threshold: 200
    duration: 10m
actions:
  immediate_rollback: true
  notify_oncall: true
```

Elena: I'll move KMS rotation out of the window to Apr 3 03:00 PT to avoid collisions. Updating change calendar.

deploy-bot: Preflight passed: infra_ready=true, kvcache_ok=true, kms_access=true, slice_quota_ok=true. Next step: canary_push at start+10m.

Ava: Customer will stand by on #northbloom-cs during canary and will provide sample validation feed.

Rahul: Final check — approvals from @Joanne, @Mike, @Elena, @Ava, @Security. If no objections by 18:00 PT today we'll lock the window and mark deploybot job as active. :lock:

Security: Ack. Reviewed KMS policies and access logs, no objections.

Joanne: :thumbsup: locking model pin and rollout plan.

Mike: :thumbsup: SLO dashboards and alerts wired up, paging thresholds set.

Rahul: Thanks everyone — window locked. I'll post release notes and customer-facing schedule in the handoff doc.
